verdict.rationale: Turso's docs and CLI explicitly support a local, server-less libSQL database file with no account needed (turso-docs-2, turso-docs-16, turso-docs-17, turso-docs-30), and a hands-on runtime probe confirms `turso dev` boots a keyless local libSQL server and successfully executes real SQL without any cloud or account dependency (turso-probe-rt-1, turso-probe-rt-2). This directly satisfies offline/local dev and CI use cases keylessly. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party CI pipeline example/tutorial demonstrating this in an automated test suite context.
